idea.title: CostRadar — Real-time LLM API cost tracker across providers

plan.tagline: Tracks real-time LLM API costs across providers
plan.problem: Indie hackers and small businesses struggle to monitor and manage their LLM API costs effectively
plan.solution: CostRadar tracks API costs in real-time, providing detailed reports and alerts to help businesses optimize their expenses
plan.target_market: Indie hackers, developers, and small businesses worldwide
plan.demo_script: Simulates real-time cost tracking, generates a sample report, and triggers a mock alert, all offline
plan.phuket_angle: Helps Phuket-based tourism businesses optimize their LLM API costs for chatbots and virtual assistants
